618-1916-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

277-864-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-864-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-864-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Eternal Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

586-728-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1621-3375-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-850-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-7297.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

1251-3259-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
1251-3259-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2232-4541-5705-5865.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-4541-5705-5865.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven Treasures.
An opponent has lost life this turn
2232-4541-5705-5865.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Flamecache Gecko from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Flamecache Gecko trigger, adding {B}{R}
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-4541-5705-5865.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

4410-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
4410-6500.description:
Activate Tephraderm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Tephraderm triggers, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

1069-1232-4478-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-4478-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2921-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
2921-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

427-1978-5776.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.

1978-5704-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.

1305-6575-7060.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

2201-2558-5687-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1350-2103-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1350-2103-6333-6678.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

2281-2438-6598.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting General Leo Cristophe.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing General Leo Cristophe.
When General Leo Cristophe dies, Saffi triggers, returning General Leo Cristophe from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When General Leo Cristophe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4636-5870-6188-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, its first ability, Gonti's Aether Heart and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the remaining triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1719-1846-4222.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
1719-1846-4222.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat from step 2

64-1309-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1309-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Warden of the Eye.
When Salvager of Secrets and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1309-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1733-2792-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Nephalia Smuggler.
Nephalia Smuggler does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1733-2792-3525.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Activate Nephalia Smuggler by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Nephalia Smuggler.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

628-2290-4050.notablePrerequisites: Spike Feeder has no +1/+1 counters on it.
628-2290-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Spike Feeder, adding one mana of any color.
Spike Feeder's undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain six life.
Repeat.

1030-2034-3562.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-3562.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sky Hussar, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1414-2730-5131-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Muldrotha.
Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill six cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, targeting Muldrotha.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

92-2298-2749.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than forty.
92-2298-2749.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you have one life.
Cast Oketra's Last Mercy by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing your life total to become forty.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose thirty-nine life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
